notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.6.2 — Gaps closed across the app

• Board → Ticket connections now uses the same picker as Production monitoring: Jira, Linear, Asana, GitHub and GitLab, each with browser sign-in where the service supports it.
• PR Guardian never auto-merges what the delivery policy holds: High or Unknown risk, a held gate, or blocking review findings stop it, with the reason.
• Desktop notifications: a macOS notification for each new item that needs you while you're in another app (Settings → Appearance → Desktop notifications).
• Production monitoring's "Suggest" works: new errors appear in the Inbox as one suggestion to investigate; nothing starts by itself.
• Council: switching presets keeps the models you chose for each member.
• Mobile Preview: choose iOS or Android, and the device; apps in a monorepo folder (like apps/mobile) are found.
• A ticket shows where its work was deployed; local tickets and documents can be removed (after confirming).
• The Outcome Graph shows real deployments of a Work Item's code instead of always "not observed".
• While you type a goal, Vekrun says early when it touches a sensitive area (payments, authentication…) that will need your approval.
• Multi-task Factory runs match acceptance criteria to existing tests, like single runs.
• In-app SSH signs in with your SSH agent (1Password, macOS), and says how to use a passphrase-protected key.
• `vekrun handover` brings work in from the command line; outside MCP clients can read the delivery decision, protections and contracts.
• Leftover internal references and outdated wording removed throughout.
